## What you will learn this week * Seasonal ARIMA models * Computing forecasts for ARIMA models * ARIMA vs ETS models ## Pre-class activities Read [Sections 9.8-9.10 of the textbook](https://otexts.com/fpp3/arima.html) and watch all embedded videos ## Tutorial exercises ::: {.callout-note} ## Tutorial Learning Objectives 1. **Develop and evaluate seasonal ARIMA models**. - Able to transform/difference seasonal series, fit and diagnose competing ARIMA models, and produce forecasts (including comparing against ETS and STL-adjusted approaches). 2. **Compute ARIMA-based forecasts manually**. - Able to use a specified ARIMA model equation and estimated parameters to hand-calculate multi-step forecasts, then fit the same model in R and explain differences between manual and software forecasts. ::: - Complete Exercises 11, 12, 13, 15 (d,e), 16 (d,e) from [Section 9.11 of the book](https://otexts.com/fpp3/arima-exercises.html). ## Assignments * GA3 is due on Tuesday 05 May. * IA4 is due on Friday 15 May. ## Weekly quiz * Week 9 quiz: Open ETF3231 quiz Open ETF5231 quiz — Due Wednesday 06 May.
